themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Far-right and national-conservative parties across Europe and the Americas are dominating campaign agendas and maintaining strong polling numbers ahead of upcoming legislative and presidential contests. From Vox positioning itself as a kingmaker in Spain to the AfD holding top polling positions in Germany and La Libertad Avanza reforming election laws in Argentina, right-wing parties are driving cross-national political momentum.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal positions Vox as an essential coalition kingmaker during intense televised campaign debates ahead of elections.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Maintains top polling position in national surveys as rival parties debate cordon sanitaire tactics and potential coalition stances.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Exerts decisive leverage over center-right coalition arithmetic as opposing parties battle over cooperation terms.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella frame policy proposals around the 2027 presidential race amid sharp attacks from President Macron.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Passes major electoral reform through the Senate to eliminate mandatory primary elections ahead of future national votes.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist parties across multiple nations are escalating demands for strict border restrictions and native-first social policy. Rhetoric demanding prioritized public services for citizens and strict remigration policies continues to spread across Western Europe.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage promises to scrap graduate visas, end free NHS care for foreigners, and prioritize British citizens for public services.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal anchors campaign rallies around 'national priority' demands, calling for immediate halts to illegal immigration.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Demands a pause on refugee intake and proposes cutting state funding for free municipal translation services.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Debates internal targets for deportation numbers and remigration policy frameworks.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Prominent right-wing figures and parties are facing intensified legal scrutiny, state surveillance, and court challenges across several democracies. Leaders are responding by framing judicial oversight as political weaponization intended to halt their rise.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella faces heavy media and legal pressure over alleged past antisemitic messages as RN leadership faces ongoing court challenges.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Party co-leader Alice Weidel attacks state surveillance agencies and warns of imminent constitutional party ban proceedings.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Jarosław Kaczyński claims legal victory against municipal protest restrictions while accusing the government of judicial overreach.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Bolsonarista lawmakers face ongoing investigations as former President Bolsonaro remains under tight court-mandated oversight.

themes.title: Pensions Overhaul and Fiscal Populism Debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders are pushing aggressive spending cuts, anti-tax populism, and resistance to multilateral budgets. From radical central bank reforms in South America to heated battles over EU budget contributions and domestic welfare spending in Europe, economic nationalism remains a primary battleground.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei celebrates central bank reform prohibiting money printing to fund government spending alongside major fiscal cuts.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes €112 billion in public spending cuts modeled on libertarian fiscal reforms to slash state bureaucracy.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni blocks EU budget expansion and magistrate pay raises while Matteo Salvini promotes nationwide tax amnesties.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen clashes with President Macron over EU budget allocations while presenting alternative national pension proposals.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Demands 55 billion NOK in tax cuts and lower electricity taxes for businesses to combat cost-of-living pressures.

themes.title: Transnational Conservative Alliances and Bilateral Right-Wing Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Conservative and right-wing figures are actively building international institutional networks, coordinating ideological platforms, and leveraging foreign political models. Diplomatic friction between left-leaning administrations and right-wing leaders highlights deepening ideological divides across borders.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Viktor Orbán establishes a new international foundation intended to consolidate patriotic and nationalist political forces worldwide.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: President Milei conducts bilateral diplomatic talks in Paraguay while being excluded from Brazilian President Lula's inauguration.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Bolsonaro allies respond to diplomatic snubs between Brazil's leftist government and Argentina's right-wing administration.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish debate coverage features Javier Milei's economic shock therapy as a benchmark for right-wing governance.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Conservative figures pursue bilateral economic and diplomatic engagements in Latin America to build transatlantic ties.
